kind: frozen prospective source and focused-test design
kernel_change: In up_fold only, accumulate u32 OR of __float_as_uint(v) during existing reach shared-memory load; replace first __syncthreads with __syncthreads_or(bits!=0). Its uniform result both publishes shared data and proves whether every logical word is exact+0. Only all+0 and finite selected payout may write every logical output amount*0.0f then return uniformly. Original fallback suffix, including later amount load, remains exact.
payout_finiteness: Selected f32 amount exponent bits !=0x7f800000; no assumed nonnegative reach or finite payout from f64 configuration.
unchanged: all fallback FP operations and order
test_scope: One actual GPU unit, direct full up_fold candidate vs pinned original up_fold-only fragment with renamed entry and minimal type/constants preamble. Both compiled with actual compute capability and the existing default CompileOptions, not a CPU arithmetic mirror. The full old CUDA string is not embedded.

test_geometry.same_combo: mixed matching indices and SENTINEL, derived from actual synthetic two-card hands
test_geometry.guards: poison whole output allocation, compare every output word between arms and require untouched rows/padding; each logical active word overwritten. All14 read-only buffers checked unchanged after each arm.

eligible_expected_output: For all+0 with finite selected amount every logical output must equal the amount sign bit as an IEEE zero, including +/-0 payout. No pre-zeroed output assumption.
fallback_validation: All observed output bits, including derived Inf/NaN, must match original GPU output exactly on executed cases. Nonzero and cancellation cases require a genuinely nonzero compatible output witness. Source review establishes exclusion predicate; equality tests do not independently prove branch traversal. No universal NaN payload/input guarantee.
counts_evidence: D066 six pre-eval snapshots establish input incidence only, not time or predicted gains. Every other CTA pays added predicate cost; unchanged fixed complete-cycle primary decides later.
qualification: Root-reviewed source and focused exact unit gate before fixed primary; >=2% and existing fixture guard remain unchanged. Broader qualification only after primary passes; no rescue/extension.
